entries.22919b68884fe818: Starting from its 'Purpose' of 'Creating memories of "You can do it if you try"', the company has evolved from an education business supporting children's independence into a 'comprehensive human resources support group' that opens up the potential of all people, from young children to seniors, and aims to realize its 'Vision' of 'Becoming a corporate group that opens up human potential and realizes a bright future'. The 3-year medium-term management plan 'MEIKO Transition', with the fiscal year ended August 2025 as its first year, positions the 3 years as an investment period, and aims to build a growth foundation by carrying out 2 initiatives, 'Business Transition' and 'Human Transition', and beyond that to become a 100-year company.
